hypotheses.justification: The bound holds without it. Proof: riskIncrease ℓ P π ≤ bayesRisk ℓ (discard 𝓧 ∘ₖ P) π by tsub_le_self. Then bayesRisk_le_iInf' (Basic.lean:96, which assumes only hl : Measurable (uncurry ℓ), for any kernel and any measure) gives ≤ ⨅ y, ∫⁻ θ, ℓ θ y * (discard 𝓧 ∘ₖ P) θ univ ∂π. Kernel.comp_discard' (Comp.lean:149) gives (discard 𝓧 ∘ₖ P) θ = P θ univ • dirac (), so that measure of univ is P θ univ, and mul_comm gives the stated right-hand side. If 𝓨 is empty, the right-hand side is ⨅ over an empty type, i.e. ⊤, so the bound is trivial. Nonempty is only needed by the current route through the equality riskIncrease_eq_iInf_sub'. It can be deleted together with [SFinite π].

Same proof as for [Nonempty 𝓨]: tsub_le_self, then bayesRisk_le_iInf' hℓ (discard 𝓧 ∘ₖ P) π, which holds for an arbitrary measure π, then Kernel.comp_discard' to get (discard 𝓧 ∘ₖ P) θ univ = P θ univ, then mul_comm. None of these steps needs π to be s-finite. SFinite is only needed by the equality riskIncrease_eq_iInf_sub' used in the current proof. It can be deleted together with [Nonempty 𝓨].
